Thanks for downloading and trying EDS, Encrypted Data Share.

== Contents ==

This folder holds the release information for EDS, which is not part of the
EDS jar itself:

* openapi.json - The OpenAPI specification of the EDS REST API, generated by
  the build.

== Running EDS ==

EDS runs on Quarkus, either directly as a JAR, or as a container. It requires
Java 25 or later.

Without any configuration, EDS uses an in-memory H2 database, which is meant
for tests and demos; all data is lost when EDS stops.

For production, EDS uses an existing PostgreSQL database. The database, user
and password must be prepared by a database administrator, for example:

  CREATE ROLE eds_user WITH LOGIN PASSWORD 'secret';
  CREATE DATABASE eds WITH OWNER = eds_user;

EDS is then started with the connection details, and creates the tables
itself at startup:

  EDS_DB_URL=jdbc:postgresql://dbserver:5432/eds \
  EDS_DB_USERNAME=eds_user \
  EDS_DB_PASSWORD=secret \
  java -jar eds-runnable.jar

If the database cannot be reached at startup, EDS stays not ready and retries
until it is reachable. EDS 2.0 requires a fresh database, as earlier versions
cannot be upgraded in place.

See RUNNING.md in the EDS sources for all options, including the container
setup and the health checks.
